placements.why: The content mandates a rollback rehearsal cadence, frames unrehearsed capability as nonexistent, and assigns ownership — this is operational architecture: the design of practices that ensure system resilience and genuine capability. No existing strata or structure holds this.
placements.title: operational architecture as the design of practices that make capabilities real
placements.frame: what practices and structures ensure that system capabilities are genuine rather than theoretical?

placements.title: unrehearsed capability is no capability
placements.frame: does the expression equate unpracticed capability with the absence of capability itself — making rehearsal the constitutive test of having?
placements.why: src-1 delivers the constitutive equivalence (unrehearsed rollback = nonexistent rollback) as a matched-clause aphorism delivered with creed-level conviction. src-2 records the monthly cadence that operationalizes the principle, and src-3 assigns the owner accountable for it. All three support the theme that capability requires rehearsal to be real — a subject future envelopes will keep feeding as rehearsal practices and capability claims accumulate.
